speaker: charlie
text: Thanks Sam, and speaking of making the most of things, Aussie swimming fans have got something massive to look forward to. <cite index='37-8,37-9'>The Australian Swimming Trials are returning to Sydney Olympic Park Aquatic Centre in 2026 - the 'Pool of Dreams' will determine the Dolphins selected for the Commonwealth Games and Pan Pacific Championships</cite>. That's where legends are made, right there.

speaker: alice
text: And here's a story that shows sport's got heart. <cite index='31-1,31-2,31-3'>Victorian Amateur Football clubs are rallying together for the BCNA Themed Round on May 9-10, supporting Breast Cancer Network Australia through their Pink Sports Day. The continued support shown by VAFA clubs has been outstanding, highlighting the strength, compassion and community spirit throughout grassroots football</cite>.

speaker: charlie
text: Love seeing grassroots footy giving back to the community. That's what sport's really about - bringing people together for something bigger than the game itself. Bloody good on them for making a difference both on and off the field.
